trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The Platinum unlocks automatically once every other trophy is earned; there is no extra task beyond them. PowerPyx puts the full run at about 200 hours on a single playthrough, and every trophy is offline and single-player, so no online play is needed. Do the story first, then the side strands, activities and collectibles, and finish with the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks automatically as you play the first mission, so just follow the story and finish it. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Finish every mission in the first chapter and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. It cannot be missed. Do the first meditation spot in this chapter too, before it closes — see Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Finish every mission in the second chapter and the trophy unlocks at its end. It cannot be missed. The asterisks in the name are how PlayStation publishes it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Finish every mission in the third chapter and the trophy unlocks at its end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish every mission in the fourth chapter and the trophy unlocks at its end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish the story's last mission and the trophy unlocks with the ending. PowerPyx says the story runs five chapters and takes about 60 to 80 hours. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically when you finish that mission, so just play the story through it. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically when you finish that heist mission. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically when you finish that mission. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically when you finish that mission. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks automatically when you finish that mission at Vice City International Airport. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically when you finish that mission. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) opens after the story, but progress you made earlier counts and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy and puts it at roughly 60% of true completion, with most of it coming from the other trophies, so finish the story, the side strands, the activities and the collectibles first, then clean up whatever checklist lines are left. Its 100% completion checklist guide lists every line and how many of each you need.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps; PowerPyx counts 397 of them across the map, and the 100% checklist needs 300, so you have room to spare. Do them as you travel and clean up the rest after the story, working through the map region by region.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Play one of every activity the game offers — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, drone races, meditation and the rest — and the trophy pops once you have sampled them all. Use the activity list in this guide to check which kinds you have tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. The official list tracks 42 Shooting Range challenges; visit the range, learn each challenge's target pattern and timing, and replay it until you hit gold. Work through them one weapon at a time and the golds stack up.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Find each drone race location, learn the course, and win at every one. Fly the fastest line through the gates and cut corners where the course allows; a win at each location is what counts, so repeat a course until you take it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Win 20 distinct race events across the game's race types; each race counts once, so vary the events rather than repeating one you like. Work through the race list and tick each new win off.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him: watch the line tension, reel in steady, and do not let the line snap. If he beats you, challenge him again — the trophy is yours the first time you win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade machine to its end; pick the shortest game if you just want the trophy, and the trophy pops when the game is completed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy unlocks when that mission ends. Take his missions as they appear and the strand leads you to the finale.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy unlocks when that mission ends. Take his missions as they appear and the strand leads you to the finale.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy unlocks when that mission ends. Take his missions as they appear and the strand leads you to the finale.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Take on stranger missions as you meet them around the map and finish 8 full strands; the map markers show where each strand starts, and the side-character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret) count toward the strands you complete.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy unlocks when that mission ends. Take his missions as they appear and the strand leads you to the finale.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission; the trophy unlocks when that mission ends. Take his missions as they appear and the strand leads you to the finale.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots in 10 locations, for Jason and Lucia. PowerPyx and GTABase flag this as the only trophy that may be missable: the first spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, so meditate there before you leave Chapter 1, then visit every other spot as you find them. Do it early and this trophy is safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand; when he asks for a unique animal, track it in the wild and take it down cleanly. Bring a scoped rifle, approach downwind, and do not spook it before you have the shot.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find the collectible cards scattered across Leonida and finish any 3 full sets; the cards are the collectible and the sets are the goal, so collect widely and the sets complete themselves. Check shops and hidden spots as well as the open map.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Find and use the WAiNK spots — 100 of them — across Leonida; check them off as you travel so you do not have to backtrack at the end. Work region by region and the count climbs fast.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Work through the game's challenges — any 50 count — and they stack up naturally across activities, so check your challenge list and finish the ones closest to done first. Races, stunts, hunting and robberies all feed it.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. A fast car, a quiet back road and no more crimes while you hide are the whole plan.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob three shops in a row with your partner alongside, keeping the wanted level from dropping between them; plan a route with shops close together, move fast from one to the next, and do not let the heat die down mid-run.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or find 100 distinct vehicles; each new vehicle you get into counts, so grab a different one whenever you see it. Variety is the whole trick — try cars, bikes, boats and aircraft as you come across them.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in range and drop all five before it ends; pick a fight with a group clustered together, then sweep through them while focus is active.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the airport did not schedule — take a plane or another aircraft and get airborne without going through the normal departure. Grab one on the tarmac and go.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank and stir up trouble; the trophy is about the Rhino, so find one — military areas are the usual source — and drive it. Causing chaos in it is the point.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, enter quietly, avoid cameras and guards, and get out without raising the alarm; a stealthy approach and a quick exit are the whole trick, so do not start a fight inside.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time; plan the escape route before you go in, and do not linger after the vault opens. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes every one of the five easier.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck, crack it open, take the cash and escape before the police close in. Ram it or block it, grab the money fast, and be gone before the response arrives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Cover the whole map — every region of Leonida counts, so drive and fly through the areas you have not visited until the map is filled in. A plane or helicopter makes the far corners quick, and the trophy pops once nowhere is left unexplored.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Find an illegal operation run by each of the game's gangs and rob each one; the gangs are spread across Leonida, so this is a tour of their territory. Hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view; it is a quiet moment trophy, so just go there and enjoy it. PowerPyx lists this among the trophies whose exact trigger is not yet pinned down, so if it does not pop at the first bar, try the other beach spots.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through a showroom's frontage and out the other side; pick a showroom with a clear run and a fast car, then floor it straight through. PowerPyx lists this among the trophies whose exact trigger is not yet pinned down, so try the main showrooms if the first one does not pop it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a game at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through properly; the trophy is about playing the alley, so just go bowl a full game there.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Build a partnership that draws a crowd — work the partnership activities until the appeal peaks and the trophy pops. The official description is deliberately vague, and PowerPyx does not pin its exact trigger down yet, so treat it as a partnership-progress trophy: keep playing the partnership activities and it will come.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make the story choices the trophy tracks; it unlocks from decisions you make during the story, so play through and make your calls — the trophy follows the choices, not a checklist. It cannot be missed on a normal playthrough, since the choices come up as the story unfolds.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something, then succeed on the second try — this one is about a second attempt paying off, so if you fail an activity or a challenge, go straight back and do it again. PowerPyx lists it among the trophies whose exact trigger is not yet pinned down, so a failed-then-passed activity is the best-known route.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Something strange happens in Leonida; find it and see it through. PowerPyx lists this among the trophies whose exact trigger is not yet pinned down, so treat it as an easter egg to chase once the community maps it — check the PowerPyx guide and the GTABase list for updates as players pin it down.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past bowlers and strike them down with a melee attack from the vehicle; a drive-by with a melee weapon is the move. PowerPyx lists this among the trophies whose exact trigger is not yet pinned down, so try it around the bowling alley and on bowlers you spot in the open.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder Marked Bills via your contacts until you have earned $250,000 from it; keep feeding bills through as you earn them and the total builds up. Robberies and heists are the steadiest source of Marked Bills.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 total across the game's shops; buy weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades as you go and the total adds up. Big purchases count fastest, so save the big buys for when you want the push.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property available; check the property listings and purchase each one. Save up first — garages are not cheap — then buy them all and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register 10 vehicles you own to the Scooter Bros app; each registration counts, so register as you acquire vehicles rather than saving them all for the end.
